messages.subject: Open post-doc position
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

We are recruiting a postdoctoral researcher at the Swiss Ornithological Institute. The main task involves modelling data from several colonies of Alpine Swifts using integrated population models. For more details and information on how to apply, please see here:

https://my.jobalino.ch/job/1a82211334f1cd4be0d27c4e611d047b/postdoctoral-researcher-in-ecological-population-modeling

Please do not hesitate to distribute the announcement to everybody who might be interested.

Thank you, and best wishes

Michael

PD Dr. Michael Schaub
Leiter Bereich "Populationsbiologie"
Dozent | Lecturer Universität Bern
Tel. ++41 41 462 97 66
michael...@vogelwarte.ch
www.vogelwarte.ch <http://www.vogelwarte.ch/>

Check out our new book about ‘Integrated Population Models’ at www.vogelwarte.ch/ipm <http://www.vogelwarte.ch/ipm>
